title: Advance Multi-digit addition
summary: Coordinate column addition, place-value exchange, regrouping marks, and a base-ten or area representation. Selection rationale: User approved the exact 26-slice place-value addition loop on 2026-07-30, clarifying the canonical visual as two right-aligned three-digit addends stacked vertically, a plus sign left of the second addend, an underline, right-to-left digit evaluation, and visible overflow digits carrying into the next column; base-ten quantities remain a secondary synchronized projection.
